name: Datacom Cable Supply
old_description: Datacom Cable Supply is a Structured Cabling and Low Voltage Wire company who provides the supplies you need for Fiber, Bulk Cable, Telecom Rooms, Workstations, and Cable Management.  We are adding to our inventory everyday and working with the best suppliers in the industry.  We stand behind our products and they exceed industry standards.  Call for a quote today, you can't beat our pricing.
about:
Datacom Cable Supply operates from Colorado Springs, Colorado, at 3415 Van Teylingen Drive in the 80917 ZIP code, where it supplies structured cabling and low‑voltage wire products. The company does not disclose a founding year or ownership structure; the contact email references Bill Jury, though his role is not specified in the available information.

The firm stocks and sells components for fiber optic systems, bulk cable, telecom rooms, workstations, and cable management. It describes its model as continuously expanding inventory while partnering with established suppliers, indicating a distributor rather than a manufacturing operation. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

The company serves customers building or maintaining structured cabling and low‑voltage installations, including telecommunications rooms and workstation environments. Specific industry verticals or named clients are not identified in the public material.

Datacom Cable Supply states that its products exceed industry standards and emphasizes competitive pricing as a differentiator, inviting quote requests by phone or email.
